name: postdaily
description: Draft, schedule and publish social posts with PostDaily — Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Mastodon.

interface.longDescription:
PostDaily is a social media scheduler for businesses, marketing teams and creators. Connect it and ask in plain words to draft, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky and Mastodon, see what is in your queue, retry posts that failed and review how published posts performed.

Before saving a post, PostDaily checks it against each network's main limits, such as length, media and thread rules, creates one post per channel and shows a preview. When you connect, you choose what the plugin may do (full access, drafts only or read only) and which workspaces it can use. Publishing a post immediately asks for your confirmation first.

You need a PostDaily account with at least one connected social channel. Disconnect any time in PostDaily under Settings → AI agents.
defaultPrompt: Check this fits Bluesky, Mastodon and Threads: Batch your week in one sitting, then let the queue post each at its best time.
Write a short Bluesky and Mastodon thread about our launch and post it now.
Show me the last post I published.

positive.prompt: What PostDaily workspaces and channels do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the demo workspace (Mehedi's Workspace) and lists its connected channels by network and handle.

positive.description: Save a post as a draft
positive.prompt: Draft a Bluesky post saying our beta is open and save it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a draft for the Bluesky channel and shows it in the post preview card with the status Draft. Nothing is published. ChatGPT may call validate_post first.

Schedules the draft for 09:00 tomorrow in the workspace timezone (Asia/Dhaka) and states the time and timezone. ChatGPT may ask for approval first, depending on the plugin's permission setting. The post publishes to a test account at that time unless it is canceled or moved back to drafts.

positive.prompt: What's in my queue for the next week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists what is scheduled in the next seven days with channels and times, including the post from the previous case if it was scheduled, and the free queue slots. ChatGPT may use list_posts instead.

positive.prompt: How did my posts do in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the posts published in the last 7 days and the numbers per channel. The demo channels have almost no audience, so impressions and engagement are near zero or unavailable. ChatGPT may use list_posts for the post counts.

negative.description: Publishing immediately without confirmation. Threads accepts text-only posts, so the only safeguard is confirmation: publishing now needs the user's explicit OK on the exact text and channel, and the plugin must show them and ask instead of publishing. Deny the request; nothing is published.
negative.prompt: Publish this to Threads right now.

negative.description: A network whose channels are disconnected. The demo workspace's TikTok channels are disconnected, so the plugin must say TikTok has to be reconnected in PostDaily and create nothing.
negative.prompt: Post it to my TikTok instead.

negative.description: A post over the network's limit. The text is longer than Bluesky's 300 characters, so nothing is published: the preview shows the channel with "Bluesky supports up to 300 characters." and the text is kept as a draft to shorten.
negative.prompt: Post this announcement to Bluesky: "We are thrilled to announce that PostDaily now supports scheduling across every major network, with smarter queues that pick the best time for each channel, a media library that keeps your images and videos in one place, analytics that show what actually works, approvals for client teams, and an AI assistant that drafts posts in your own voice. Try it today and tell us what you think!"

review.commerce_description: PostDaily does not sell anything or take payment in the chat. When a workspace reaches a plan limit, the tool states the limit and links to the public pricing page.

publication.release_notes: First directory release. Draft, validate, schedule and publish posts for PostDaily workspaces, with a post preview, confirmation before publishing now, the queue, media upload and analytics.
